items.title: 'Epic Seven' 8th Anniversary Update Adds Moonlight Hero 'Lisette'
items.summary: ⓒ SmilegateSmilegate announced on August 28 that it has launched a major update and events to celebrate the 8th anniversary of the official launch of 'Epic Seven,' a mobile turn-ba...
items.content:
Smilegate announced on August 28 that it has launched a major update and events to celebrate the 8th anniversary of the official launch of 'Epic Seven,' a mobile turn-based strategy RPG developed by Super Creative.

This update unveils the new side episode 'Paradise Lost' and adds key character 'Lisette' as a playable Moonlight Hero. Quality-of-life improvements and new PvP content were also introduced.

Added on August 27, 'Paradise Lost' is set in the first era of the world's lore, where destruction and restoration repeat. It explores the story of 'Kayron,' known to players as a villain, during his human days. Like the first side episode 'Rain of Fading Embers' released last year, all dialogue features full voice acting.

'Lisette' is a Hero with lore establishing her as a fragment of Goddess 'Diche' who descended in human form to prevent the world's destruction. She gains 4 stacks of 'Divinity' at the start of battle, which can be consumed to revive allies when they die. When used in the Divinity state, her third skill, 'Converged Time,' triggers 'Time Reversal' on all allies, resetting those Heroes to their state immediately after the battle began.

The repeat battle feature, 'Background Battling,' has been improved to allow battles to auto-run and earn rewards even while offline. Auto-sell and auto-extract features for equipment have also been added.

A new mode, 'The Call of Chaos,' has been introduced to the real-time PvP content World Arena. In this mode, players field 3 Heroes each and compete to destroy the opponent's rear-guard 'Guardian' first, with battle-selected effects known as 'Fate' applied during combat.

An 8th anniversary celebration event is also underway. From August 27 to October 29, a total of 1,260 free Covenant Summons will be available, and the bunny girl-themed skin for 'Majestic New Moon Luna'—the 1st place winner of the 2025 Hero Popularity Poll—is being provided as a login reward. '8th Anniversary Coins' earned in this year's Hero Popularity Poll can be exchanged for 5-Star Hero Summon Tickets, commemorative illustrations, and more.

In the 'Shining Moments' event, collecting points through play missions sequentially unlocks service records and rewards. Rewards include a Limited 5-Star Hero Selector, growth materials, and a Moonlight 5-Star Selector featuring the Natalon Academy universe. The 8th anniversary update will roll out sequentially starting on August 27.

items.title: Epic Seven's 8th Anniversary Update: Everything Revealed
items.summary: Epic Seven's 8th anniversary showcase revealed a new episode, a roguelike mode, a Chaos Zero Nightmare collab, a Steam launch, and much more.
items.content:
Gaming Epic Seven's 8th Anniversary Update: Everything Revealed GameDaily Follow Franz Christian Irorita Mon, August 24, 2026 at 7:30 PM UTC Mon, August 24, 2026 at 7:30 PM UTC Epic Seven 's 8th Anniversary Infinity Showcase brought a genuinely large wave of announcements, from a new story episode and heroes to a Steam launch and a major crossover collaboration. Here's everything that has been revealed.

The anniversary showcase revealed a new Side Episode, Paradise Lost, set in the 1st World, the earliest setting in the Epic Seven universe.

Two new heroes join alongside it: Lisette, the alter ego of Goddess Diche, a Light-elemental Soul Weaver built around reviving and restoring allies, and Uncharted Pioneer Politis, introduced at the moment of her first landing on Orbis in the 1st World, whose role shifts depending on where she's placed on the team.

Acolyte of the End Kayron will factor heavily into Paradise Lost's story and gets a separate, dedicated introduction later, while a character named Kain will appear as a playable NPC rather than a summonable hero.

Background Battling now keeps running even after the game is closed, with players able to register up to 100 Leif, roughly 400 runs, and duration now calculated against a player's actual clear records rather than a flat estimate. New auto-sell and auto-extract options for Equipment are coming alongside it.

An Equipment Charm Payback Event starts August 27 and runs three weeks, returning a set percentage of invested EXP as Greater Charm Selection Chests. Ogre's Armory is being folded into the Hunt menu as new content called Ogre Hunt, available at Otherworld Difficulty and offering Reversal, Riposte, Warfare, and Pursuit Sets.

Rift is being temporarily suspended starting August 27 for content restructuring. Profile Cards are also getting a refresh, with layers increasing from 100 to 130, saved slots doubling from 5 to 10, and new colors, shapes, emoji placement, direct coordinate input, PC shortcuts, and a gift-to-friend option added.

A new World Arena mode called The Call of Chaos brings 3v3 arcade-style PvP with a fast pick-ban phase, roughly a minute long with up to three rerolls, followed immediately by combat.

The goal is to destroy the opponent's Sentinel, with players able to trigger various ally buffs or enemy debuffs by choosing a "Fate" mid-battle. Runs end at 7 wins or 3 losses, with better rewards for more wins, and players earn Ranking Points and shop currency along the way, with season-based ranking rewards on top.

Super Creative is bringing its other major title into Epic Seven this September, crossing over with Chaos Zero Nightmare .

Renoa arrives as a free character during the collaboration period, while Haru and Mei Lin will be available through Limited Summon. Several collaboration events, including a Counseling Center and dedicated shop, will run in Witchaven for the duration.

It's a natural pairing for Super Creative, which has been actively cross-promoting CZN alongside its other titles at events like Anime Expo 2026 as the newer, darker-toned game builds its own audience.

Epic Seven 's first official roguelike mode, Dimensional Exploration, launches with unlimited attempts and no entry currency required.

Players form a 3-Hero team, choose special effects through Expedition Supplies, and can assign up to three additional heroes to tag slots to swap in mid-battle, for up to seven usable heroes total.

items.title: Epic Seven is Coming to Steam This Year Along with a Chaos Zero Nightmare Collaboration
Epic Seven Unveils 8th Anniversary Updates Including Steam Store Page Launch
items.summary: Provided by Epic Seven ©Epic Seven Smilegate announced on Monday, August 24, that Epic Seven, the mobile turn-based strategy RPG developed by Super Creative, revealed details on ne...
items.content:
Smilegate announced on Monday, August 24, that Epic Seven, the mobile turn-based strategy RPG developed by Super Creative, revealed details on new content, events, and the opening of its Steam store page through the showcase video "Infinity," celebrating its 8th anniversary of official launch.

The showcase video was released on the official Epic Seven YouTube channel at noon on Saturday, August 22. In the video, Executive Producer Kwang-jin Tak and Development Director Dae-kyun Heo, who lead the planning and development of Epic Seven, shared future update plans and details on interactive offline events for the 8th anniversary.

The news of Epic Seven's expansion to Steam attracted the most attention in the video. Epic Seven will officially launch on Steam within this year, as part of a platform expansion addressing global players' demand for a Steam release. To this end, the Steam store page opened on August 22, launching a Wishlist Event that grants various currencies and items based on the number of wishlists reached. Players can play on Steam through account transfer supported by STOVE, and a new server will also be provided alongside the official Steam launch. The new server will operate as an independent matchmaking server for a set period to accommodate players starting Epic Seven for the first time. In addition, controller support will be added to the Steam service to offer a unique gameplay experience. The exact launch schedule will be announced at a later date.

Various 8th anniversary update details were also unveiled. A new side story Episode, "Paradise Lost," which covers the earliest era in the Epic Seven lore—where the world repeatedly falls into ruin and is rebuilt—will begin on August 27, with new heroes such as "Lisette" and "Uncharted Pioneer Politis" introduced sequentially. A collaboration with Smilegate's another popular IP, Chaos Zero Nightmare (CZN), is also underway. Key combatants from CZN will be added as Epic Seven heroes, along with "Dimensional Exploration," a new roguelike PvE mode. Meanwhile, a new real-time PvP mode, "Call of Chaos," will be added to the World Arena. Players can look forward to unpredictable battles in every match using "Destiny," a powerful effect chosen during combat.

In terms of quality-of-life improvements, the introduction of an offline feature for battle delegation (repeat battling) drew significant interest. Once added, players can collect growth materials through repeat battles while offline, which is expected to further ease the burden of hero progression.

Information on offline events scheduled through the second half of the year, starting with the 8th anniversary celebrations, was also announced. On Saturday, August 29, the "Festival of Everlasting Successors" will be held on the 12th floor of Hyundai Department Store Sinchon Branch with approximately 160 players. Executive Producer Kwang-jin Tak and Development Director Dae-kyun Heo will attend the event to communicate directly with fans. Furthermore, a collaboration cafe will operate on the B2 floor of Hyundai Department Store Sinchon Branch for about a month, from August 29 to September 30. In addition, the global esports tournament to determine the ultimate Epic Seven World Arena champion, the Epic Seven World Championship (E7WC 2026), will kick off on September 12 with in-game qualifiers. The Grand Finals are scheduled to take place on Saturday, November 28 at the Lotte World Tower Super Plex in Jamsil.

Meanwhile, an 8th anniversary event packed with generous rewards will begin on August 27, offering all players a total of 1,260 free Covenant Summons and the bunny girl-themed "Majestic New Moon Luna" skin, which won first place in a player popularity poll.

Detailed information about Epic Seven can be found on the official Epic Seven community and official YouTube channel.

items.title: Epic Seven Unveils Summer Hero Orb Update
‘Epic Seven’ “Secret Summer” Update Live—New Limited Hero, Story, “Epic Dash” Event
items.summary: This week, developer Super Creative and publisher Smilegate have launched their latest summer update to their free-to-play turn-based role-playing game
items.content:
This week, developer Super Creative and publisher Smilegate have launched their latest summer update to their free-to-play turn-based role-playing game title ‘Epic Seven’ across PC and mobile platforms. This seasonal update includes a new Limited Hero, a Special Side Story, and the latest “Epic Dash” event. A special summer coupon code, “E7SUMMERGIFT26”, is also available for redemption until 26 August—you can redeem it in-game or by clicking over here .

The Limited Hero introduced for the 2026 summer season is Eye of the Abyss Fumyr. As a central figure in the newly added Special Side Story, “Show Me What Lies Within,” she visits the Aelo Coast to track the whereabouts of Harsetti, the sovran of Shadow Elves, only to find herself swept up in a series of unexpected incidents.

Eye of the Abyss Fumyr is a 5★ Earth Elemental Mage obtainable until July 16. Her Skill 3, “Eye of the Abyss,” inflicts “Detain” on the foremost enemy Hero, temporarily removing them from the battlefield. This allows players to collapse the enemy’s frontline and drive the battle to their advantage.

Story starring Fumyr will run for six weeks until 6 August. Set against a coastal backdrop, the narrative features a diverse cast of characters alongside Fumyr, including the information broker “Birgitta” and her assistant “Aube.” Notably, as players progress through the story, they can play a classic “territory-capture” style arcade mini game to acquire various rewards, including high-quality illustrations.

Meanwhile, the “Epic Dash” event will take place from June 25 to August 27, offering massive benefits for Hero acquisition and growth. Players can clear daily and weekly missions to level up their “Mission Pass” rank and claim rewards. Depending on their rank, players can obtain a 5★ Hero Selector that provides a Hero with all progression fully completed, a 5★ Limited Hero Selector, a standard 5★ Hero Selector, various Summon Currencies, Equipment Sets, and more.

Also, as part of the Epic Dash lineup, the “Premium Moonlight Summon” event will grant players up to 100 free Moonlight Hero summons simply by logging in daily. As an extra milestone bonus, players will receive a 5★ Light Elemental Hero Summon Ticket upon performing 20 summons, and a 5★ Dark Elemental Hero Summon Ticket upon performing 100 summons. Finally, the update brings the “Lucky Dash” event, where players can obtain various Equipment and Charms, alongside the “Epic Dash Buff” event, which provides several powerful in-game buffs.

The developer has also prepared a set of “Secret Summer Digital Merchandise” featuring wallpapers of some of Epic Seven’s heroines. You can download the images from the game’s official website (bottom of the page) to grab copies tailor-made for your PC, mobile, tablet, and watch.

Epic Seven is available as a free-to-play title across PC via STOVE , iOS , and Android via Google Play .

items.title: Epic Seven Releases New Shepherd of the Dark Diene Update
items.summary: Epic Seven has released a brand-new Moonlight Hero, Shepherd of the Dark Diene, along with additional content in the latest update
items.content:
Posted in: Games , Mobile Games , Video Games | Tagged: Epic Seven , Smilegate , Super Creative

Epic Seven has released a brand-new Moonlight Hero, Shepherd of the Dark Diene, along with additional content in the latest update

Smilegate and developer Super Creative has launched a new update for Epic Seven , bringing with it a new character. Players now have access to Shepherd of the Dark Diene, a new Moonlight Hero who brings a different set of attacks and more to the fray, along with a New Year's event to kick off 2026. We have more details here as the content is live today.

Shepherd of the Dark Diene is a country girl who, after encountering a black wolf in the forest, forms a contract with Noias, the Dark Spirit Lord, who has appeared for the first time in centuries. Driven by her admiration for the Hero "Aki" and her unwavering determination, she embarks on her journey to save the world. But as her journey unfolds, it begins to transform into something dark and twisted. She is a 5★ Dark elemental Mage Hero who can lead battles to her advantage by utilizing various effects that trigger when she is granted "immortality." Her Skill 1, "Crimson Claws," inflicts rupture on the enemy, and a successful attack always results in a critical hit. Damage dealt increases proportionally to the caster's max Health. When the caster is granted immortality, it triggers a Dual Attack from the ally with the highest Attack.

Her Skill 2, "Noias's Guidance," grants immortality for 1 turn at the start of battle. Additionally, when someone uses a Soulburn, dispels all debuffs from the caster before activating "Dark Moon," which dispels buffs from all enemies, grants immortality to the caster for 3 turns, and increases Combat Readiness by 35%. Her Skill 3, "Endless Darkness," inflicts seal on all enemies for 2 turns, and attacks them before decreasing Combat Readiness by 30%. Also, a successful attack always results in a critical hit. When the caster is granted immortality, they ignore Effect Resistance.

To celebrate the New Year, Smilegate will also be running several in-game events. First, the "New Year Check-In Event" will run for three weeks until the 22nd. Players can log in to receive a New Year's greeting from Merurin. The New Year's Gift Chest includes Lv. 88 Equipment and "Fire Horse Stamps," which can be used in concurrent events. The second event, "Collect New Year Stamps," will run during the same period. By consuming Energy daily, players can obtain "Leif" and the event currency, "Fire Horse Stamps." In the third event, "New Year's Gift Arrived!," players can use the "Fire Horse Stamps" earned from the two events mentioned earlier to open random chests containing rewards such as MolaGora and Charms. Finally, in the "Merurin's Lucky Pouch" event, players can clear simple missions to earn various rewards, including a final reward of 1,000 Skystone.

items.title: Epic Seven World Arena Championship 2025 attracts 61% more viewers than 2024
items.summary: The Epic Seven World Arena Championship 2025 drew 61% more viewers than last year, peaking at over 28,000. With expanded coverage, global co-casters, and thrilling matches, this year’s event became one of the most-watched tournaments in Epic Seven history
items.content:
On September 6, the Epic Seven World Arena Championship 2025 concluded at the YES 24 Live Hall in Seoul, South Korea. Thanks to a combination of factors, which we'll get into in detail below, it ended among the three most popular competitions in the game's history.

The most prestigious event in Epic Seven's calendar carried a prize pool of $100,000, the joint-most in the mobile role-playing title's competitive history. It brought together 64 of the world's best players as they vied for the title of world champion.

Epic Seven World Arena Championship 2025 – basic viewership stats and top channels

After around three weeks of action, Xiao Xuenai beat GOMEAWME 4:2 in the Grand Final to emerge as the victor and the title's newest world champ. For this achievement, he took home $50,000 and some special items, including a trophy, a Hero Skin, and a ring, with another reward to be revealed at the end of the year.

"After six years in Epic Seven, I've finally made it to the top of RTA. Standing at the bottom and looking up at that peak felt overwhelming, but I was blessed to have true companions by my side throughout this journey. I want to thank Smilegate from the bottom of my heart for hosting the 2025 World Championship, and I'm deeply grateful to my Shadow Council members — Hazamarei, Keith, Second, and everyone else — for all their support along the way. I'm so proud that I could make our shared dream come true by bringing this championship home to the Council. My sincere thanks also go to the Ps streaming community, Blue Sky, and everyone who stood behind me. I hope all the Heirs find their true friendships and passion within the world of Epic Seven."

- Xiao Xuenai, after clinching the Epic Seven World Arena Championship 2025

The Epic Seven World Arena Championship 2025 peaked at 28,315 Peak Viewers on the first day of the event: August 16. On this day, the second installment of the Epic Seven 7th Anniversary Showcase was released , revealing updates for the second half of the year and including insights from the development team about future developments for the mobile RPG.

This helped it comfortably beat the concurrent viewers mark set at the Epic Seven World Arena Championship 2024 by 61%. It also ended in the third spot when looking at the most popular tournaments in the title's esports history, sitting behind the 2022 and 2023 editions.

Comparing the viewership statistics of the last two E7 World Arena Championships

One big reason for this massive jump from 2024 was the number of channels covering the event. It shot up from 33 to 84 this year, helped by an increased interest shown by a lot of community streamers, which also meant that two extra platforms covered the action in 2025: CHZZK and Kick.

What is heartening is the fact that many Western co-casters jumped at the chance to livestream the games and finished among the top channels list . Considering that Epic Seven is a niche game with a core market in Korea, the fact that Spanish and Portuguese-speaking content creators showed high interest helped take the title and its coveted competition to a lot of new viewers .

With a format that included multiple qualifiers and a main event in a double round robin leading into quarterfinals, semifinals, and a best-of-seven grand final, the Epic Seven World Arena Championship 2025 also finished as the game's second-most-watched competition ever. Only the 2022 iteration is ahead by this metric.

Epic Seven has joined a list of games boasting a more regional presence, like Honor of Kings, in seeking to expand its audience base recently . Making its most prestigious tournaments more visible and accessible via co-casters and broadcasting in more languages has paid dividends for the 2025 World Arena Championship, which easily outperformed last year's edition and put up some of the title's best livestreaming numbers.

As more and more such games adopt this method, it will be interesting to see how their livestreaming numbers hold up in the coming years. Esports Charts will continue to monitor tournaments across genres and tiers , and readers interested in detailed stats for such competitions can check out our Events Dashboard .
